variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single landscape concept image for Lost City, location four of a Roblox underwater football world. Input image is ONLY a style, scale and camera reference: retain its beautiful toy block construction, studs, elevated three-quarter view and extremely long wide straight football lane receding from lower-left foreground to upper-right distance; replace the kelp forest environment completely with a sunken ancient city. Render a polished, very beautiful hand-modelable Roblox 3D toy environment with big clear forms and consistent studs. The central lane is flat pale turquoise mosaic tiles with subtle cream squares, fine white football markings and turquoise edging. Keep the entire lane and the wide volume directly above it completely empty for ball flight. Side scenery is on broad cream sand banks and blue block stone terraces, all objects fully visibly supported. Cyan turquoise underwater atmosphere, luminous sun shafts and soft caustics, readable bright palette, small bubbles. Architecture is large simple cream stone blockwork with turquoise mosaic trim, stepped roofs, shell statues. A shoal of silver fish swims well above the very distant arch, beyond the playing zone. A distant gateway may sit beyond the far boundary only and must have a very high clear opening. No bridges or overhead structures across the playing corridor. No UI, lettering, words, logos, watermark, real-world photography, photogrammetry or excessive tiny clutter. One single wide landscape picture, not a collage. Composition: OPEN SUNKEN CIVIC PLAZA, unusually open airy low silhouette. Broad low blue-stone platforms spread far to both sides. Left foreground contains a large circular stepped basin with a simple shell sculpture, dry sand-filled underwater fountain; behind it a few broken square columns and low wall fragments with turquoise mosaic panels. Right side features open low colonnade ruins and scattered shell plinths, with two small stepped-roof civic buildings far behind. The architecture stays mostly low, with generous negative space and broad sand courtyards. A small monumental arch at the far end, outside the play volume, becomes the distant focal point. Cream predominates in ruins, turquoise mosaics and a few peach coral clusters provide accents. Hero image with a distinctly open plaza silhouette.
